title: Mike Read's Computer Pop Quiz
build: TAP of the original Elite cassette (1,530,784 bytes): a 512-byte Novaload boot program in the KERNAL's format, then 26 Novaload files: the loader's second stage, the loading picture, the program in four files, and five question blocks of four files each, which the game loads during play

tools.host: Linux x86_64 (WSL2) on Windows 11 Pro 10.0.26200, Ubuntu, Intel x86_64
tools.emulator: own build of github.com/barryw/vice-mcp, release v3.13.2, commit 1e83aab134; check-emulator 57 of 57

accuracy.note: the lead and five helpers, one at a time, each on its own address range or part

checked by a fresh agent that wrote none of the comments: 3 variable comments missed a reader or writer in another part or loop, 2 named the wrong colour target (screen colours for colour RAM and back), 1 widened a range of zero-page bytes, 1 said 255 records for 256, 1 misread which byte a store writes; all 8 corrected, with 10 more comments that said the same (the other three operands of the colour-clear loop, the other seven sprite pointers)

the Play tab's port, every routine tested against the game's code and the whole game run in lockstep: 5 comments were wrong (where two steps go after picking their item, which member ends a team pick, how often the subject choice runs, how the question builder spaces a bracket) and 4 more were completed; all 9 corrected
